description: Master source of truth for all internal company documents in the Knowledge Assistant inventory

documents.title: Travel and Expense Policy (Americas)
documents.summary: Americas meal allowance USD 75/day; receipts above USD 25
documents.body: Employees travelling within the Americas region may claim a daily meal allowance of USD 75. Receipts are required for any single expense above USD 25.
key_facts: receipts required for single expense above USD 25

documents.title: Travel and Expense Policy (EMEA)
documents.summary: EMEA meal allowance EUR 60/day; receipts above EUR 30
documents.body: Employees travelling within the EMEA region may claim a daily meal allowance of EUR 60. Receipts are required for any single expense above EUR 30.
key_facts: receipts required for single expense above EUR 30

documents.title: Travel and Expense Policy (APAC)
documents.summary: Proposed APAC meal allowance JPY 8000/day (under review)
documents.body: A proposed daily meal allowance of JPY 8,000 for APAC travel. This policy is under review and has not yet been approved.

documents.title: Remote Work Policy
documents.summary: Up to 3 remote days/week with manager approval
documents.body: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week, subject to manager approval. Effective January 2026.
key_facts: up to 3 days per week remote work

documents.title: Remote Work Policy (2023 edition)
documents.summary: Up to 1 remote day/week (superseded by D-004)
documents.body: Employees may work remotely up to 1 day per week. Superseded by the current Remote Work Policy (D-004).

documents.title: Production Data Handling Standard
documents.summary: No local copies of production data; use approved sandbox
documents.body: Production data must not be copied to local machines. Use the approved data sandbox. Sandbox access requires team-lead approval.
key_facts: must not copy production data to local machines

documents.title: Compensation Review Process
documents.summary: Q1 cycle; manager discretion budget 4% of team payroll
documents.body: The annual compensation review runs in Q1. Each manager has a discretionary budget of 4% of their team's payroll.
key_facts: annual compensation review runs in Q1
discretionary budget is 4% of team payroll

documents.title: Procurement Approval Thresholds
documents.summary: Above USD 10k VP sign-off; above USD 50k CFO sign-off
documents.body: Purchases above USD 10,000 require VP sign-off. Purchases above USD 50,000 require CFO sign-off.
key_facts: purchases above USD 10,000 require VP sign-off
purchases above USD 50,000 require CFO sign-off

documents.summary: Draft EMEA vendor onboarding checklist (not approved)
